title: UK Launches £100M AI Scheme in First Rapid Procurement Route for Startups
summary:
The UK government opened the Sovereign AI R&D Procurement Scheme to provide £100M in contracts to domestic AI startups. Initial projects focus on increasing NHS productivity, integrating AI across defense environments, improving public compute efficiency, and the safe adoption of AI agents.

The scheme removes traditional barriers to government contracts by eliminating minimum turnover and cash reserve requirements while allowing companies to retain their intellectual property. The launch occurs amid increasing opposition to UK government contracts with Palantir.

selectedTweets.text:
Government as your customer.

Our Sovereign AI R&D Procurement Scheme, a new route for ambitious British AI companies to work directly with government to tackle real-world challenges and deliver public benefit, is now LIVE.

We’re taking a different approach to government procurement, creating opportunities for startups that traditional routes can often make difficult to access.

We’ve designed this scheme around the realities of building a startup.

That means no minimum turnover, net asset or cash reserve requirements, a streamlined application process, companies retaining their IP, and upfront payments available where needed to help cash-constrained startups participate.

With up to £100m available, companies can work directly with public-sector users to build against real challenges, prove their technology and create a pathway to commercial scale.

Government gets innovative solutions to real challenges. British AI companies get a customer and a pathway to scale.

And these are just the first challenges.

Applications OPEN.

One of the great challenges for British start-ups has been selling to our own Government - until now.

Gov procurement has often discriminated against innovative new British companies. @UKSovereignAI has set out to change that, and after a lot of work, we've just launched our rapid procurement scheme - the first of its kind in the UK.

This is £100M of contracts for British AI companies to deliver services to make our public services cheaper and more efficient. 

This scheme is designed around the needs of start-ups: No turnover minimums. Departmental champions from day 1. Upfront payments. Streamlined applications. You keep your IP.

We are launching with four initial schemes, with more to come later this year. 

These are: 
- Providing AI for a more productive NHS
- Integrating AI across Defence environments
- Making public compute more efficient
- Safe adoption of AI agents.

If you think you might bid for one of these, you can first check your eligibility and learn more about the schemes on the website below
